section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Broad Conceptualization of Beauty Scale (Tylka & Iannantuono, 2016), a 9-item single-factor measure rated from 1 (completely disagree) to 5 (completely agree), with Cronbach's α = 0.81. Confirmatory factor analysis indicated adequate model fit (RMSEA = 0.072, χ2 (24) = 6.79, CFI = 0.954, TLI = 0.932, SRMR = 0.039). No sample demographics, BMI assessment, or correlations between body appreciation and BMI are reported in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: The Broad Conceptualization of Beauty Scale (Tylka & Iannantuono, 2016) was used to measure broad conceptualization of beauty. Participants indicated their agreement with statements (e.g., "Even if a physical feature is not considered attractive by others or by society, I think that it can be beautiful") on a 5-point scale ranging from 1 (completely disagree) to 5 (completely agree). Cronbach's α was 0.81. CFA was performed to assess the 9-item single factor model, and the model adequately fit the data, RMSEA = 0.072, χ2 (24) = 6.79, CFI = 0.954, TLI = 0.932, SRMR = 0.039.
